newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 459 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 459 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight Monday agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 459 contracts, compared with 543 contracts traded overnight Sunday, according to the CBOT.
There were 45 wheat, 252 corn, 123 soybean, one oat, 10 soymeal, seven soyoil, three corn call, 16 corn put and two soybean put contracts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 3/4 to two cents higher, corn was 3/4 to 1-1/4 cents lower and soybeans were one to 1-1/4 cents lower.
